### 💡 Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is (e.g. *I'm always frustrated when...*).

### 🚀 Proposed Solution / Feature
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how it benefits GATE aspirants.

### 🔄 Alternative Solutions Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or diagrams about the feature request here.
